firstYear: A four-year honours degree. First year is programming, computer systems and software engineering (COMP1511, COMP1521, COMP1531), with data structures and algorithms (COMP2521) already in the third term, alongside UNSW's higher-level maths (Higher Mathematics 1A and 1B) and discrete maths. Later you choose a major in Computer Science, Security Engineering or Artificial Intelligence, and the final year is a three-part research thesis.
notThis: Not a different field from UNSW's Bachelor of Computer Science. It is the same subject taken deeper: higher maths in first year, an extension course in algorithms and programming, and a research thesis built into year four.
